## Is your feature request related to a problem?

A clear and concise description of what the problem is. Ex. I'm always frustrated when [...]

## Describe the Solution You'd Like

A clear and concise description of what you want to happen. Include how it
would work from a user's perspective and, if relevant, how it might be
implemented.

## Describe Alternatives You've Considered

A clear and concise description of any alternative solutions or features you've
considered, and why they are insufficient.

## Use Case

Describe the use case or workflow this feature would improve. Who benefits and
how?

## Additional Context

Add any other context, mockups, screenshots, or references about the feature
request here (e.g. how other editors implement it, relevant papers or
specs, etc.).
